name: ImageSlider
description: One large image per view with a glass caption, a counter, previous and next buttons, dots and optional thumbnails, on the carousel machine. Arrow keys on the dots follow the text direction.

livewire.name: image-slider
capabilities: wire:model binds the slide shown (index) through $wire.entangle()
Images also accept the 2.x url key for src, and plain URL strings

props.name: images
props.description: The slides, in order: { src, alt, caption, description }. The caption is the glass card's title.
props.a11y: Every image needs alt text. Captions are text, never baked into the image.

props.name: aspectRatio
props.description: The frame's aspect ratio, as CSS takes it ("16 / 9"). Livewire also takes the 2.x "16:9". Emitted as --apui-_image-slider-ratio.

props.name: index
props.description: The slide shown, 0-based. Livewire binds it with wire:model. Pair it with index-change to control it.

props.name: defaultIndex
props.description: The initial slide of an uncontrolled slider.

props.name: loop
props.description: Wraps from the last slide to the first and back.

props.name: autoplay
props.description: Advances every interval ms, with a pause button. It pauses while the pointer or focus is on the slider.
props.a11y: Autoplay always has a visible pause button (2.2.2).

props.name: interval
props.description: Milliseconds between slides while autoplay runs.

props.name: thumbnails
props.description: Shows a strip of thumbnails under the frame.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the slider region. Translate it: Livewire defaults it through __( 'Photos' ).
props.a11y: A page with several sliders names each one.

props.name: previousLabel
props.a11y: The button is icon-only, so this is its only name.

props.name: nextLabel
props.a11y: The button is icon-only, so this is its only name.

props.name: indicatorLabel
props.description: A dot's accessible name. {index} is replaced; Livewire's __() string uses :index.

props.name: slideLabel
props.description: A slide's accessible name. Livewire's __() string uses :index and :count.

props.name: counterLabel
props.description: The counter text. Livewire's __() string uses :index and :count.

props.name: playLabel
props.description: The autoplay button's name while paused.

props.name: pauseLabel
props.description: The autoplay button's name while playing.

props.name: classes
props.description: Extra classes per part, such as { viewport: '…', caption: '…' }.

parts.name: root
parts.description: The carousel's region: role region with aria-roledescription carousel, named by label.

parts.name: viewport
parts.description: The rounded frame at aspectRatio, holding the track and the overlays.

parts.name: item
parts.description: A slide: role group with aria-roledescription slide, named "2 of 6"; slides out of view are aria-hidden.

parts.name: image
parts.description: A slide's image, covering the frame.

parts.name: caption
parts.description: The glass card at the frame's start foot, with the slide's title and description.

parts.name: progressText
parts.description: The glass counter ("2 / 6") at the top end. The spec calls it counter; it keeps Zag's name (D-019).

parts.name: prevTrigger
parts.description: Shows the previous slide: a soft, neutral icon-only Button. The spec's nav (prev).

parts.name: nextTrigger
parts.description: Shows the next slide. The spec's nav (next).

parts.name: indicatorGroup
parts.description: The glass row of dots at the foot's end. The spec calls it dots.

parts.name: indicator
parts.description: A dot that shows its slide; aria-current and a wider primary pill mark the one shown.

parts.name: autoplayTrigger
parts.description: Pauses and resumes autoplay, with autoplay.

parts.name: thumbs
parts.description: The strip of thumbnails under the frame, with thumbnails.

parts.name: thumb
parts.description: A thumbnail that shows its slide; aria-current marks the one shown.

events.name: index-change
events.description: The slider moved to another slide: a button, a dot, a thumbnail, a swipe or autoplay. Setting index doesn't fire it.

keyboard.action: Move between the previous and next buttons, the dots and the thumbnails.
On a button, dot or thumbnail: shows its slide.
On the dots: show the next or previous slide. They follow the text direction, so in RTL ArrowLeft shows the next slide.
On the dots: show the first or last slide.

requirements: The root is a region with aria-roledescription carousel and a translatable name.
Each slide is a group with aria-roledescription slide, named by its position; slides out of view are hidden from assistive technology.
The track is a polite live region, off while autoplay runs, so moves are announced.
Every image has alt text; captions are text over a glass card, never baked into the image.
The previous and next buttons and the dots have accessible names (translatable); the dot shown carries aria-current.
Autoplay has a pause button and stops while the pointer or focus is on the slider (2.2.2).
Arrow keys follow the text direction; the previous and next icons mirror in RTL.
Glass falls back to the raised surface under reduced transparency and in high contrast.
Every part keeps a stable, server-rendered id in Livewire (D-015).
